transcript: Hi Karen, it's Maria from Brightwater Health. I'm calling about your dad's discharge on Friday.
Oh good. Dad's home, but the pharmacy said his new heart pill needed some approval.
Yes, I see that. Has he taken any lisinopril since he got home? The hospital stopped it.
Mom picked up a refill Saturday because it came automatically... I think he took one yesterday morning.
Please put the lisinopril aside and don't give any more. I'll call the pharmacy and his cardiologist about the new medicine today.
Okay. He's also a bit puffier in the ankles, and the scale says 86.
That's up almost 2 kilos. Is he short of breath at rest or needing more pillows?
Not at rest. Maybe one extra pillow.
The discharge plan is furosemide twice a day. Does he have enough tablets for that?
He's been taking one in the morning. We only have the old bottle.
I'll fix that with the pharmacy. Can you get him to Dr. Velasco on Wednesday? I can book it now.
Wednesday afternoon works, but I'll need to drive him. Mom doesn't drive anymore.
